web.title: Rafael Nadal career statistics
web.description:
# Rafael Nadal career statistics
[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rafael_Nadal_career_statistics#cite_note-1)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rafael_Nadal_career_statistics#cite_note-2) To date, Nadal has won 92 [ATP](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Association_of_Tennis_Professionals) singles titles, including 22 [Grand Slam](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Slam_(tennis)) men's singles titles and 36 [ATP Tour Masters 1000](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ATP_Tour_Masters_1000) titles.

## Significant achievements
He is also the first of two male players to win three consecutive [Grand Slam](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Slam_(tennis)) tournaments on three different surfaces (clay, grass, and hard courts) in the same year (2010), a feat later achieved by Djokovic (2021).
